titleStmt.title: King Śibi in the Vahnipurāṇa
A critical edition of the śiber upākhyāna

summary.p: This edition of the Vahnipurāṇa śiber upākhyāna, by Charles Li, was published in Asian Literature & Translation in 2023 (doi:10.18573/alt.58). It includes diplomatic transcriptions of every witness used to edit the text. An introduction to the text, as well as a translation, can be found in the article.

lg.l: śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi svamāṃsaṃ śibinā yathā |
samāṃśaṃ dattavān satyaṃ purā hy auśīnaro yuvā || 1 ||
satyadānarataṃ jñātvā śibim indrāśuśukṣaṇī |
jijñāsārthaṃ sameyātāṃ vartamāne mahādhvare || 2 ||
vahnir bhūtvā kapotas tu hariśyenāt puraḥsaraḥ |
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ || 3 ||
trāhi māṃ pṛthivīpālety avadac chyenajād bhayāt |
sa tam āśvāsayāmāsa kapotaṃ śaraṇāgatam || 4 ||
rājānam upagamyātha śyenaḥ provāca saṃsadi |
vacanaṃ śṛṇu me rājan kṣudhārtasya kuṭumbinaḥ || 5 ||
dharmātmānaṃ tvām āhur vai pṛthivyāṃ sarvapārthivāḥ |
tadviruddhaṃ kathaṃ karma kartum icchasi pārthiva || 6 ||
kṛtaghnā bhavatā dānaiḥ sādhunāsādhavo jitāḥ |
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇaḥ satyenānṛtavādinaḥ || 7 ||

standOff.note: Cf. , Āraṇyakaparvan appendix I, 21.45-46: ...auśīnaraḥ sādhuśīlo bhavato vai mahīpatiḥ || jayet kadaryaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinam | kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet || (vol. 4, 1071); 4.11: bhavān kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinam | kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet ||; Dhammapada 223: akkodhena jite kodhaṃ asādhuṃ sādhunā jine | jine kadariyaṃ dānena saccenālikavādinaṃ || (ed. Sumangala 1914, 33).

lg.l: sarāgā vītarāgeṇa tathākopena kopinaḥ |
satṛṣṇā vītatṛṣṇena tvayā lokāḥ parājitāḥ || 8 ||
sarvasya sampadaḥ svārthāḥ svaparārthās tu kasyacit |
parārthā bhavato nityaṃ saphalasya taror iva || 9 ||
nopakārapare 'py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |
apakārapare 'pi tvam upakāraparaḥ sadā || 10 ||
mamaiva vihito dhātrā bhakṣo 'yaṃ taṃ samutsṛja |
rakṣantam ātmano dharmaṃ kṣudhitasya kapotakam || 11 ||

standOff.note: Cf. Anuśāsaṇaparvan, appendix I, 8.41: yas tu me vihito bhakṣaḥ svayaṃ devaiḥ sanātanaḥ (vol. 17, 855); 4.34: vihito 'smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣaṃ kapotakaḥ | tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryam anyair nareśvara ||

lg.l: sa śyenam āha saṃprāptas trāṇārthī sannidhau mama |
khago 'syāsmin kathaṃ kuryāṃ tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitam || 12 ||
lobhād dveṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajec charaṇāgatam |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 13 ||
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahātus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit || 14 ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastā rakṣitavyāḥ prayatnataḥ || 15 ||
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair magnāḥ saṃsārasāgare |
jantavaḥ parikliśyante mṛtyos trasyanti te tataḥ || 16 ||
yannimittaṃ bhavec chokas trāsaḥ krodho bhayaṃ tathā |
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāṅgam api taṃ tyajet || 17 ||
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate |
śakyas tenānumānena paro 'pi parirakṣitum || 18 ||
yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyam |
saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitam || 19 ||

standOff.note: The reading nirīkṣyate results in 4 uniform pādas, in vaṃśasthā metre.

Cf. Vasudevahiṇḍi: jaha jīviyaṃ tubbhaṃ piyaṃ nissaṃsayaṃ tahā savvjīvāṇaṃ (ed. Caturvijaya & Puṇyavijaya 1931, 337); Uttarādhyayanaṭīkā: jahā jīviyaṃ tuha piyaṃ, niyayaṃ taha hoi savvajīvāṇaṃ | piyajīviyāṇaṃ jīvāṇaṃ, rakkha jīvaṃ sajīvaṃ va || (ed. Vijayomaṅgasuri 1936, 244v). As in the Vasudevahiṇḍi, witnesses , , , & only have the first half of this verse.

lg.l: tasmāt tavāhaṃ na samarpayiṣye kapotakaṃ śyena yad atra yuktam |
tvaṃ manyase tat karavāṇi sarvam ṛte kapotāt khalu satyam atra || 20 ||
bhavanti sarvabhūtāni āhāreṇa janeśvara |
jīvanti ca vivardhante āhāreṇa na saṃśayaḥ || 21 ||
āhāraṃ puṣkalaṃ kurvan ciraṃ jīvati prāṇabhṛt |
na tv āhāravihīno 'pi śaknoti jīvitum ciram || 22 ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyādya mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyanti panthānam apunarbhavam || 23 ||
mṛte mayi nṛpaśreṣṭha putradārādikaṃ kulam |
vinaśyati kathaṃ dharmo bhavitā te nṛpottama || 24 ||
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ parantapa |
avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate || 25 ||
tasmād virodhe dharmasya niścitya gurulāghavam |
manyase gauravaṃ yatra tat kuruṣva nṛpottama || 26 ||
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam || 27 ||
nāto gurutaro dharmaḥ kaścid anyo 'sti khecara |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 28 ||
varam ekasya sattvasya pradattaṃ jīvitābhayam |
na ca viprasahasrasya gosahasram alaṅkṛtam || 29 ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi |
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ || 30 ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalam |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 31 ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣayo nāsti kutaścana || 32 ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā |
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 33 ||
catuḥsāgaraparyantāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imām |
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyo yo dadāti tato 'dhikaḥ || 34 ||
api tyaje rājyam ahaṃ śarīraṃ vāpi dustyajam |
na tv enaṃ bhayasantrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakam || 35 ||
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiñcit tena janmani janmani |
bhavet trātā mahārtānām ārtināśāya dehinām || 36 ||
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavam |
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanam || 37 ||
yathā tv ananṛtāṃ vāṇīm aham etām udāhare |
satyena tena bhagavān prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ || 38 ||
āhārārthe samārambhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṅgama |
tad yathaiva tavāhāraṃ manyase tad dadāmy aham || 39 ||
śyenaḥ prāha mamāhāro na ṛte 'tra kapotakam |
tat tyaktvā kāmaye nānyam āhāraṃ rājasattama || 40 ||
tasmāt tvam api bhūpāla dehi nyāyārjitaṃ dhanam |
dānāj jñānaṃ tataḥ prāpya jñānāt siddhim avāpsyasi || 40bis ||
śyenaḥ kapotakān hanti sthitir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan sāram ajñātvā kadalīskandham āruha || 41 ||
rājāvocad amārgeṇa varte nāhaṃ kvacit khaga |
dharmaśāstropadiṣṭo 'yaṃ dharmaḥ sattvadayāparaḥ || 42 ||
sarvasattveṣu yad dānam ekasattve tu yā dayā |
sarvasattvapradānāc ca dayaikātra viśiṣyate || 43 ||
sarvavedā na tat kuryuḥ sarvaśāstrāṇi khecara |
sarvatīrthābhiṣekāś ca yaḥ kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayām || 44 ||

standOff.note: Cf. Anuśāsaṇaparvan 116.18: sarve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarvayajñās ca bhārata | yo bhakṣayitvā māṃsāni paścād api nivartate || (vol. 17, 627); Viṣṇudharma 62.4: sarvavedā na tat kuryuḥ sarvadānāni caiva hi | yo māṃsarasam āsvādya sarvamāṃsāni varjayet || (ed. Grünendahl 1984, 101). On the relationship between the Viṣṇudharma and the Vahnipurāṇa, see Hazra 1954, 79ff.

lg.l: vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
dayādarśitapanthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te || 45 ||

standOff.note: In the Vahnipurāṇa, Rudra is identified with Agni (Hazra 1954, 79).

lg.l: gacchaṃs tiṣṭhan svapan jāgrad yo hitaṃ na samācaret |
narebhyaḥ sa paśur jñeya ātmano 'py ahitaḥ sa vai || 46 ||
duḥkhino 'duḥkhino vāpi prāṇino labdhacakṣuṣaḥ |
ātmavat paripaśyanti te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 47 ||
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 48 ||
tubhyaṃ hi sumahad rājyaṃ prayacchāmi vihaṅgama |
yathā kāmayase vānyad varjayitvā kapotakam || 49 ||
śyenaḥ prāha kim etat te prītir āsīt khage dṛḍhā |
kathaṃ ced asya tulyāni svamāṃsāni prayaccha me || 50 ||
rājā tam abravīd dhṛṣṭo yan me māṃsāni yācase |
etad yacchāmi te sadyaḥ svamāṃsaṃ tulayā dhṛtam || 51 ||

standOff.note: Cf. also Anuśāsanaparvan, appendix I, 8.44: tatas tvaṃ me prayacchādya svamāṃsaṃ tulayā dhṛtam (vol. 17, 855).

lg.l: yat prārthito 'smi bhadraṃ te priyam etad dadāmi te |
satyadharmaratasyātha sataḥ sumahad apriyam || 52 ||
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |
dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmaṃ śocyo 'sau mūḍhacetanaḥ || 53 ||
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho 'yaṃ nopayujyate |
tataḥ kim upakāro 'sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā || 54 ||
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni kapotena samaṃ nṛpaḥ |
utkṛtya tolayāmāsa prahṛṣṭo manasā tataḥ || 55 ||
tyaktvātmasukhabhogecchāṃ sarvasattvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ |
bhavanti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ || 56 ||
tulayā dhriyamāṇas tu kapoto vyatiricyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ || 57 ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso 'pi sādhuḥ sukhāyate param |
yadā tena na tulyaṃ tat sa tulām āruhat svayam || 58 ||

standOff.note: See verse 63 below.
& omit 'pi sādhuḥ... tat. Cf. also verse 62.

lg.l: antaḥpuravarastrīṣu na rājye na ca jīvite |
karuṇāsaktacittena tenāpekṣā kṛtā kvacit || 59 ||
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ svasukhāni mahānty api |
nāpekṣante mahātmānaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ || 60 ||
parārtham udyatāḥ santaḥ santaḥ kiṃ kiṃ na kurvate |
tādṛg apy ambudher vāri jaladais tat prapīyate || 61 ||
eka eva satāṃ mārgo yad aṅgīkṛtapālanam |
dahantam akarot kroḍe pāvakaṃ yad apāṃpatiḥ || 62 ||
ātmānaṃ pīḍayitvāpi sādhuḥ sukhāyate param |
hlādayaty āśritān vṛkṣo duḥkhaṃ ca sahate svayam || 63 ||

standOff.note: Cf. 104: aṅgīkṛtyātmano duḥkhaṃ sukhayaty aparān mahān | ātapād ātapastho 'yaṃ pathikān avati drumaḥ ||

lg.l: atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe |
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ca || 64 ||
tatas tasya tadā jñātvā dharme rājñaḥ parāṃ sthitim |
śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vākyaṃ caitad abhāṣata || 65 ||
indro 'ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau || 66 ||
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ tat suduṣkaram |
naiva pūrve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyanti cāpare || 67 ||

standOff.note: Cf. Suvarṇavarṇāvadāna 77.6cd: mahākāruṇikeneva yat sattvārthaṃ mahat kṛtaṃ (ed. Rajapatiratna 1974, vol. 1, 80).

lg.l: parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prītir abhavat tava |
prāṇasaṃkṣayalabdheṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehinām || 68 ||
parārthaikāntakalyāṇī svāśrayārthārthaniṣṭhurā |
tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan karuṇākaruṇābhavat || 69 ||
svakarmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat |
tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa || 70 ||
anāthe vikale dīne nirdhane 'rthini rogiṇi |
adṛṣṭe dṛṣṭapūrve vā tulye ca karuṇā tava || 71 ||
yathābhibhūya sarvāṇi jyotīṃṣy arko 'vatiṣṭhate |
tathābhibhūya karuṇā tava dharmān avasthitā || 72 ||
akṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca |
agatvā sadṛśaiḥ spardhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ || 73 ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān yo naraḥ parirakṣati |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ || 74 ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā || 75 ||

standOff.note: reverses the two lines.

lg.l: paśavo 'pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ |
sa jīvati punaḥ ślāghyaṃ parārthaṃ yas tu jīvati || 76 ||
kiṃ cātra citraṃ yat santaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ |
na hi svadehaśaityārthaṃ jāyante candanadrumāḥ || 77 ||
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā |
sa paraṃ padam āpnoti parād api hi yat param || 78 ||
paropakāraikamanāḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhaḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tv īdṛśā bhuvi || 79 ||
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samutkṛtāni pārthiva |
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrtir lokān anu bhaviṣyati || 80 ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā mahīṃ ciram |
sarvāṃl lokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi || 81 ||
evam uktvā tam indrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayam |
rājā tu kratum iṣṭvā taṃ mumude devavat tadā || 82 ||

standOff.note: Cf. & : ity uktvā taṃ dānapatim indrāgnī tau tadā nṛpa | pūrṇadehaṃ svakaṃ kṛtvā jagmatus tridaśālayam || For pāda c, reads svarṇadehatvacaṃ kṛtvā.

lg.l: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śibeś caritam uttamam |
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ svargalokaṃ sa gacchati || 83 ||

body.p: iti ādye vahnipurāṇe śiber upākhyānaṃ nāma ||

standOff.note: Cf. 4.17: tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya mayārthinaḥ | kathaṃ asmadvidhaḥ kuryāt tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitam ||

See also Prabhāsakhaṇḍa 1.29.60cd–61ab, kāmāt krodhād bhayāl lobhād yas tyajec charaṇāgatam || 60 || satyād vāpi sa vijñeyo mahāpātakakārakaḥ || (1909/1910, 50r). In that context, brahmahatyāsamaṃ might be inappropriate, since the verse is spoken by the ocean to the brāhmaṇas, who have cursed him.

For śaraṇāgatahātuḥ, Kaulāvalīnirṇaya 10.124 reads kulabhraṣṭasya, while Narasiṃhapurāṇa 50.51 reads kṛtaghnasya. In the quotation from the Adhikaraṇacintāmaṇi (), the verse is similarly followed with tathā ‘kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ’ iti.

This verse also appears at the end of NGMPP A 936/5, a codex unicus of the Cittaviśuddhiprakaraṇa. It is not very legible, and only the first half of the verse was published by H. P. Śāstrī, who called it a well-known formula (1878, 177). The microfilm image from the NGMPP clearly shows that the full verse is present, and it seems to have the same reading as . In the manuscript, it is followed by a verse from the Mṛtyuvañcanopadeśa: ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ sarvasiddhāntasaṃmataḥ....
See also a variation on this verse recorded in Edgerton's apparatus to the Vikramacarita (1926, 297).

Mahābhārata readings taken from Śāntiparvan 168.34 (, vol. 15, 957; , vol. 14, 105-106). This verse is also attested in Śāntiparvan 26.25 (, vol. 13, 95-96) & Anuśāsanaparvan appendix 1, 15.3959-3960 (, vol. 17, 1014).
& render this verse in anuṣṭubh metre, making it significantly shorter.
The first half of this verse can also be found in Sūktiratnahāra 14.3, erroneously referred to as 18.3 in the Mahāsubhāṣitasaṃgraha (Sternbach 1974, 292).

There are many versions of this verse across the Mahābhārata, Vahnipurāṇa, and Bhaviṣyapurāṇa. The version from spans three lines, the last line of which is a scribal addition in the top margin of the manuscript.
Between the two halves of this verse, inserts: na bādhā vidyate yatra taṃ dharmaṃ samudācaret || gurulāghavam ājñāya dharmādharmaviniścaye | reads samupācaret for samudācaret.

On yataḥ śriyaḥ, cf. Nāradasmṛti 1.25cd: bhūtam eva prapadyeta dharmamūlā yataḥ śriyaḥ, [The king] should resort to fact alone since dharma is the root of his prosperity (ed. & trans. Lariviere 1989, I, 15; II, 9).
On kuruṣva dharmaniścayaṃ, comments, unepic cadence!
For more variant readings, see Indische Sprüche, Böhtlingk 1870, 258.
See also the Subhāṣitasaṃgraha of Muni Sukhasāgara, which has the same reading as & (1933, 15); Devendrasūri's autocommentary on the Dānopadeśamālā has the same reading as (ed. Ramyareṇu 2002, 6).
For the variant reading kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm in & , cf. verse 33 below.
Many more variations on this verse are attested; see Mahāsubhāṣitasaṃgraha 2249–2251 (Sternbach 1976, 501–502).

Although the wording of the last pāda here is awkward, it seems that it is the most likely reading. The Caturvargacintāmaṇi quotes two versions of this verse: one version matches this one and is attributed to the Vahnipurāṇa; the second, attributed to the Mahābhārata, matches the version in the Itihāsasamuccaya.

Cf. Nāradīyamahāpurāṇa 2.26.3: nāparaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ vasudhāṃ vasu kiṃcana | muktvaivaṃ vāsare viṣṇor bhojanaṃ pāpanāśane ||; Bhāgavatapurāṇa 9.21.12: na kāmaye 'haṃ gatim īśvarāṇām aṣṭarddhiyuktām apunarbhavaṃ vā | ārtiṃ prapadye 'khiladehabhājām antaḥsthito yena bhavanty aduḥkhāḥ || (ed. Narasimhacharya 2005, 289). Satya Vrat Shastri comments, A well-known stanza in Sanskrit circles but its source is not traceable (2009, 165).
On na ṛte, see Oberlies 2003, 9–12.

This verse is quoted in under the entry for siddhiḥ and attributed to the Vahnipurāṇa Śiber upākhyāna. It may be a mistaken attribution. The verse appears near the end of the Mudgalopākhyāna immediately preceding the Śiber upākhyāna, in both the Vahnipurāṇa and the Itihāsasamuccaya; quotes the Itihāsasamuccaya. It also appears in the Padmapurāṇa, near the end of the Venopākhyāna. It has been tentatively inserted here, assuming that the editors of had a version of the Śiber upākhyana in which this verse appears.
Cf. also Anuśāsanaparvan, appendix I, 8.42 (vol. 17, 855), which has the same reading as in the Āraṇyakaparvan.
